components.summary: One evaluation engine for tree and single-system files, bounded solve, residual assembly and signal mapping
responsibilities: Use one evaluation engine for tree and single-system files through HierarchicalAuditRunner. Validate inputs and finite solver bounds before residual evaluation Hierarchical run retains reference solving and diagnostics; generated mapping ledgers have no separate review API. For failed observed audits, probe at most 20 observed dependency ancestors for bounded unit factors/offsets, rederive affected native values, and emit hints without editing observations.
Separate numerical optimization success, observed audit and diagnostic limits

Derive intermediate values from connections and bounded one-unknown relations with finite structural value/control provenance; keep producing occurrences separate from independent checks and list unresolved inputs; preserve per-result sources through finite native tuple/dict returns, lexical helpers and fixed numeric parameter tables
Treat connections as physical identities with a tight default residual scale or an explicit positive finite tolerance
Report an observed value without a source signal or unit as a mapping gap
Record stale_when as review conditions; mark mapping stale only from explicit mapping_status stale

Roll child failures into parent verdicts while preserving own scores; compare linked coarse checked relations and report unbuilt refinement targets as planned and resolve built templates without execution; render declared component contracts, ownership and connections without solving; render one tree view for the declared structure and, when given, the verdicts of an evaluation or a variant run
side_effects: Temporarily chain and restore the current-thread Python trace while collecting partial-snapshot native residual dependencies
